params.body:
## Why

The bidding screens still carried the Bootstrap grid (`row`, `col-md-*`, `page-titles`, `form-group`, `btn btn-info`) while the rest of the app has moved to the `ui-` vocabulary plus Tailwind. This first PR takes the three page heads, the shared bidding-fields partial and the 404 page. Visual migration only: no logic moved, no numbers changed, no route or handler touched.

`ExportVehicle::DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS` is still the only source of the end date in `form.blade.php`, called exactly as before.

## Reachability

| View | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `export/header.blade.php` | used by `export/index.blade.php` and `export/biddingDetails.blade.php` (routes `export.index`, `export.show.biedingen`) |
| `export/ongoing_won/header.blade.php` | used by `export/ongoing_won/index.blade.php` (`ongoingexport.index`, `wonexport.index`) |
| `export/bidding_offers/header.blade.php` | used by `export/bidding_offers/index.blade.php` (`biddingoffer.index`) |
| `export/form.blade.php` | used by `export/createmodal.blade.php` (`export.create.showmodal`) and `ownstock/_tabs/general.blade.php` |
| `export/export_vehicle_not_found.blade.php` | used by `ExportController@showDetail` (`export.show.detail`) when the vehicle behind the bidding is gone |

No unused view in this batch; nothing to propose for deletion.

## What per view

- **`export/header.blade.php`** — `row page-titles` + `col-md-8` / `col-md-4` becomes `ui-page-head` with `ui-page-title` and `ui-page-actions`, the same shape the relations and users heads already use. The intro line keeps its place under the title as a Tailwind paragraph. The average-price button, its Alpine modal and `id="average_price_button"` are untouched. The back link goes from `btn btn-sm btn-info` to `ui-back-link`, keeping `data-tip` / `data-tip-pos`.
- **`export/ongoing_won/header.blade.php`** — same move; the `$type == 1` branches for title, intro line and back route are unchanged.
- **`export/bidding_offers/header.blade.php`** — same move; the comment explaining the missing subtitle stays.
- **`export/form.blade.php`** — `row pt-3` + `col-12` / `col-md-6` becomes `ui-form-grid ui-form-grid--2`, with the bidding type spanning both columns from `md` up (`md:col-span-2`), which is what `col-12` next to two `col-md-6` did. `form-group` becomes `ui-field`; the `control-label` class drops because `.ui-field > label` styles it. Field names, the `x-ui.select` / `x-ui.input` calls and the `readonly` dates are identical.
- **`export/export_vehicle_not_found.blade.php`** — the theme's `error-box` / `error-body` and `btn btn-info btn-rounded m-b-40` become `ui-empty` plus `ui-button ui-button--primary`. The old markup rendered badly: the footer floated over the content and the 404 filled half the screen (see the before shot).

## JS hooks kept

- `id="average_price_button"`.
- `.export-bidding_type` / `.export-start_date` / `.export-end_date` and the `help-block help-block-danger` spans: `merchant.validate()` (bound in `createmodal.blade.php`) walks `$form.find('.help-block')` on a failed save.
- `data-tip` and `data-tip-pos` on every back link (the vanilla tooltip in `x-ui.tip` reads them).
- All `route()` targets, `$errors` lookups and `@include('layouts.message')` calls unchanged.

Grepped `resources/js/**` for every id and class before renaming: nothing in scripts refers to `page-titles`, `text-themecolor`, `error-box`, `btn-rounded` or the `col-*` wrappers.

## Screenshots

Taken at 1280 and 390 from the real rendered pages (logged in, two seeded biddings), before and after:
`tw-export-before-*` / `tw-export-after-*` for `ongoing`, `createmodal` (the shared form), `notfound`, `index`, `details`.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` on every compiled view: clean.
- `npm run build`: green (`public/build` untracked, not committed).
- `phpunit --filter='SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|Bidding|Export|ExportDocuments'`: 137 tests, 783 assertions, OK.
params.title: Bidding screens to the ui- vocabulary (1/3): page heads, bidding form, 404
